name: Lord of the Wings
source:
Ding dong, your tank is dead. To resurrect her, you accept a quest to take a duck to the neighbouring city under strict instructions to NOT open the cage. 

Enjoy duck puns galore, a wealth of truly terrible jokes, and — sometimes spicy but mostly dumb — romance with the adventurer of your choosing.

[from [url=https://marysuegames.itch.io/lord-of-the-wings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
叮咚，你们队伍里的坦克死了。为了复活她，你接下任务，要将一只鸭子送往邻城，并被严令禁止打开笼子。

尽情享受铺天盖地的鸭子谐音梗、糟糕透顶的笑话，以及与你选中的冒险者之间，偶尔火辣、大多傻气的恋情。

[摘自[url=https://marysuegames.itch.io/lord-of-the-wings]itch.io[/url]]
